policy.coordinate: finite f32 quantized to signed i32 at 1e-4, round halves away from zero
policy.weld: first occurrence by exact quantized xyz
policy.degenerate: duplicate vertex or zero projected XY signed area
policy.orientation: positive Z; swap vertices 1 and 2 when negative
policy.manifold: reject any undirected edge incidence above two before and after collapse
policy.volume: sum the signed six-times-volume determinant over every simplified face in canonical order; the generated planar open fixture must equal exactly zero and makes no watertight-volume claim
policy.simplification: collapse each odd quantized X column onto the preceding even X column, remap every face in source order, then remove collapsed faces; ties resolve to the first simplified vertex
policy.serialization: 16 little-endian i32 header words, simplified quantized xyz, then selected face indices
